    Exact defects form Serre subcategories #

    The coherent-duality equivalence is defined on exact defects. To compare uniseriality there with uniseriality in the ambient finite-functor category, we identify the exact defects by their vanishing on projective or injective modules. This file begins with the two direct vanishing implications.
